menu.signOutEverywhereDescription: This signs out every device including this one. You'll need to sign back in.

activeSessions.title: Active sessions
activeSessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account. Revoke any that you don't recognize.

sessions.confirmDescription: You'll stay signed in here. Every other browser and device will need to sign back in.
sessions.reauth: For your security, the list of devices needs a sign-in from the last hour.

linked.connectFailed: Couldn't connect Google. Use the Google account with this email address, and try again.
linked.onlyMethod: Your only sign-in method — set a password before disconnecting it.
linked.reauth: For your security, sign in again before disconnecting — your session is more than an hour old.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Name and avatar shown to teammates.
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF, up to 20 MB.
profile.name: Name

email.title: Email
email.description: We'll send a confirmation link to your current address.
email.hint: Two steps: approve from your current inbox, then confirm from the new one. Your current email stays active until then.
email.confirmationSent: Step 1 of 2: we sent an approval link to {{email}}. It expires in 1 hour.
email.pendingApprove: Step 1 of 2 — open the link we sent to {{email}} to approve the switch to {{newEmail}}.
email.pendingVerify: Step 2 of 2 — open the link we sent to {{newEmail}} to confirm it. Your email changes then.
email.pendingExpiry: Links expire after 1 hour. If yours has, request the change again.
email.approved: Change approved. Now confirm from the link we sent to {{email}}.
email.linkFailed: That link is invalid or has expired. Request the change again.

connected.title: Sign-in methods
connected.description: Ways you can sign in to this account.

password.title: Password
password.description: Other sessions will be signed out after a change.
password.hint: Avoid passwords you've used elsewhere. The meter below shows real-time strength.
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.
password.setDescription: Your account has no password yet. Add one to sign in with your email and password.
password.added: Password set. You can now sign in with it.

errors.session_not_fresh: For your security, sign in again before setting a password — your session is more than an hour old.
errors.password_already_set: This account already has a password.
errors.unknown: Could not set the password. Try again.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.description: Permanently remove your profile and all organization memberships. This cannot be undone.
danger.dialogDescription: We'll send a confirmation link to {{email}}. Click it to permanently delete your account. If you change your mind, ignore the email and nothing happens.
danger.confirmationSent: Confirmation sent to {{email}}. Click the link within 1 hour to permanently delete.
danger.blockedTitle: Make someone else an owner, or delete the organization
danger.blocked: You're the only owner of the organizations below. An organization can't be left without an owner: make another member an owner of each one, or delete the organization, then come back.
danger.lastSuperAdmin: The platform can't be left without a super admin: make someone else a super admin from the admin screen, then come back.

deleted.title: Your account was deleted
deleted.body: Your profile and your organization memberships are gone. Thank you for using interw.

signin.title: Sign in to confirm the deletion
signin.body: For your safety, this link only works where you're signed in to the account being deleted. Sign in and we'll bring you straight back to finish.

invalid.title: This link can't be used
invalid.body: It has expired or was already used. Request a new one from your profile.

blocked.title: Your account wasn't deleted
blocked.body: You're the only owner of an organization, or the platform's last super admin. Your profile says what to hand over first; then request the deletion again.
